race.comment: Stacks of chances in a real test for punters. STORM SEASON (1) gets the nod on the back of a dominant all-the-way win over this course and distance 16 days ago. Takes on the boys with 61kgs but she is tough as nails and up to the task. SUPERFABULISTIC (2) led and gave a kick but was nailed late when resuming over 1400m at the Kensington track last time out. Has raced here twice over 1600m and won them both. Fitter for that last run and should be in this for a long way. WITHOUT PEER (8) has been freshened up since driving hard late but just missing over this track and trip a month ago. Competitive at stakes level as a three-year-old so this is certainly within reach third-up. AURA (15) probably found 1800m a bit far when second-up recently. Fitter now and from a good draw with the light weight makes plenty of appeal. DORADUS (4) will roll forward and can run a cheeky race dropping back to the mile.
